outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic timeline of the differentiation protocol, not a data plot.
Panel B shows western blots, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C consists of line plots with error bars (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel D is live fluorescence/brightfield microscopy imaging, not a plot.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter/density plots where each point represents an individual cell measurement, not an average summary.
Panel F is a line plot with error bars (mean ± SEM per caption); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G is a line plot with error bars (mean ± SEM per caption); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H is immunofluorescence micrograph imaging of whole-mount EBs, not a plot.
Panel I consists of Tukey boxplots, which already display data distribution (quartiles, median, whiskers) and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel J is a heatmap with hierarchical clustering; heatmaps are exempt since individual data points are not meaningful in this representation.
